title: Support XCCDF 1.1 in xccdf-results-to-hdf converter
description: The xccdf-results-to-hdf converter currently only handles XCCDF 1.2 (namespace http://checklists.nist.gov/xccdf/1.2). DISA STIGs use XCCDF 1.1 (namespace http://checklists.nist.gov/xccdf/1.1). Need to support both versions, with and without results. Similar to the SARIF multi-version issue (bead 2zq).
notes: [2026-03-09] Completed: Full XCCDF 1.1 support + benchmark-to-baseline + auto-detect. Removed NS prefixes from Go XML struct tags. Added ConvertXccdfBenchmarkToHDF, ConvertXccdfToHDF. 4 CLI format names (xccdf, xccdf-benchmark, xccdf-results, arf). 52 Go tests, 15 CLI tests, 84 TS tests all passing. Files: converter.go, converter_test.go, converter.ts, converter.test.ts, converter_registry.go, converter_xccdf.go, converter_xccdf_test.go, 2 new fixtures.
close_reason: XCCDF 1.1 support, benchmark-to-baseline, and auto-detect fully implemented in both Go and TypeScript. All tests passing, lint clean, schema validation verified.

title: Fix double URL-encoding of project path in GitLab fetcher
description: hdf fetch gitlab --project wdower/juice-shop returns 404 due to double URL-encoding. url.PathEscape produces %2F, then url.URL.Path re-encodes to %252F. Numeric IDs work. Fix: set both Path and RawPath, or construct URL string directly. File: hdf-cli/internal/fetchers/gitlab.go line ~139-148.

title: Add --ca-cert and --insecure TLS flags to all API-based fetchers
description: None of our API-based fetchers (Splunk, SonarQube, GitLab, AWS Config) support custom CA certs or insecure TLS bypass. Implement shared NewHTTPClient() with --ca-cert, --insecure flags and HDF_CA_CERT, HDF_INSECURE env var fallbacks. Register at parent convert command level.
